name: el Mangroove Hotel

transfer_minutes.label: Approximately 30 to 40 minutes by private transfer from Guanacaste Airport (LIR) in Liberia.

hero_image_alt: el Mangroove Hotel, a Luxury Beachfront Resort in Gulf of Papagayo, Costa Rica
description: El Mangroove is a contemporary luxury beachfront resort on the Gulf of Papagayo, blending modern design with tropical nature. With a tranquil pool, two ocean-view restaurants, and a nature-set spa, it delivers a refined yet relaxed Pacific coast escape.
hero_description: Contemporary luxury on the shores of Costa Rica's Gulf of Papagayo.
local_insight: Ideal for design-minded travelers who want polished luxury paired with genuine Costa Rican adventure. The private tour boats make it a standout for guests who want easy access to fishing, surfing, and whale-watching without leaving the resort's orbit.

faq.a: El Mangroove sits on the Pacific coast in Guanacaste, along the shores of the Gulf of Papagayo.

faq.q: What airport is nearest to El Mangroove?
faq.a: It is closest to Guanacaste Airport (LIR) in Liberia, typically a 30 to 40 minute private transfer away.

faq.q: What activities does the resort offer?
faq.a: Yes, as the only hotel in the area with two private tour boats, it offers deep-sea fishing, surfing, whale and dolphin watching, and national park excursions.
